meta.title: BUILT
meta.author: Joe Guadagnino / Lupton Associates
meta.style: Apple keynote energy — extreme macro process shots with sparks into the lens and fast camera moves, an exploded-view assembly that slams together, type that lands hard on the beat
meta.note: Corrects the mistake in One Print: every seedance prompt there said 'camera locked off', which killed the drama. Here every prompt demands a rushing, orbiting or whipping camera.

grid: 120 BPM. Every cut lands on the beat grid the score is built from: 0, 4, 7, 10, 13, 19.5, 23, 27.5 s.

shots.visual: extreme macro fiber laser, camera RUSHES the cut line, sparks explode toward the lens (seedance 2.5 t2v)
shots.vo: Every part you buy starts as a print. / Cut.

shots.visual: press brake punch descends, camera tracks low and whips up as the metal folds
TIG arc ignites, camera orbits fast, sparks fill frame
sage powder coat bursts across the part, camera whips around; graded toward brand sage
exploded view — four components drift apart, camera orbits (start_image = nano_banana_pro exploded keyframe)
shots.vo: Most buyers run that across four different shops. Four purchase orders, four people to call when the holes don't line up.

shots.visual: the four components RUSH together and lock into one assembly, white impact flash, camera pushes in
shots.vo: We do it under one roof.

shots.visual: finished assembly hovering, camera orbits, specular streak sweeps the surfaces
shots.vo: One print, one project manager, one team that owns the fit.

shots.visual: black; Send us the print. -> badge + Let's build it together. (sage) + Luptons.com
shots.vo: Send us the print. Let's build it together. Luptons dot com.

voiceover.status: FINAL — Joe Guadagnino's own recording (Webster_Golf_Club_7.m4a, 34.8 s, one continuous take).
voiceover.processing: highpass 85 Hz to drop room rumble, afftdn nr=10 for broadband hiss, alimiter; sliced only at Joe's own pauses (silencedetect -45 dB / 0.22 s), each phrase RMS-matched to -20 dB with 12 ms fades.
voiceover.tempo: BU6, BU7 and BU8 run atempo=1.06 — Joe's read of the problem section is more deliberate than the placeholder, and the 6% lift lets it hand off to the slam line on the beat. Everything else is at his natural pace.
wordingChanges: Joe said 'four DIFFERENT shops' (script said 'four shops') — on-screen label stays the condensed 'Four shops.'
Joe said 'one TEAM that owns the fit' (script said 'one shop') — the on-screen line was changed to 'One team that owns the fit.' so the caption matches the voice.
voiceover.verified: audio-only transcription over black confirmed all phrases and their wording before slicing; assembled master re-verified the same way.
voiceover.note: BU8 joins two of Joe's breaths ('four people to call' / 'when the holes don't line up') with the gap tightened from 0.70 s to 0.18 s.

music.bed: bu_music.wav — original numpy score, 120 BPM. Sub pulse every beat, 16th hats opening up as the film builds, A-minor-pentatonic arpeggio entering at 4 s and lifting an octave at the hero, riser 17.5-19.5 s, big low hit + crack + shimmer on the slam at 19.5 s, resolve at 27.5 s, fade 31.2-33.0 s.
music.license: original — no third-party music, no credit required in the post

sfx: native seedance ambience carried under laser (0.26), brake (0.20), weld (0.24), coat (0.18) and slam (0.22); everything else is score only
